content_zh:
根本无法解释，但是即便以现如今的科技，对于超古代文明，也依旧有很多未解之谜。
不过他相信，绝对不是梦，只是不知道什么原因，他得到了丹皇记忆的传承而已。
他的身体也在那个梦之后，产生了变化。
但是这种变化，他觉得是好的，现在的他，只觉得前所未有的神清气爽，看世界都觉得颜色更加鲜艳，听声音也觉得更加清晰了，全身上下感觉好像有使不完的力量一样，有一股力量澎湃在其中。
他不敢将这种变化告诉任何一个人，他本能的觉得如果说出去的话，只怕会是轩然大波，那是一个皇者的记忆啊，他甚至可能被抓去做小白鼠切片研究！
他只是有点奇怪，不知道丹皇的山河图跑哪儿去了，还有山河图中卷着的神格也不知道哪儿去了。
想了好一会儿，都想不明白，楚云凡也只有放弃了，很快他就将心思收了回来，开始修炼。
他的脑海之中，浮现出了一篇口诀，正是《基础练气口诀》，这《基础练气口诀》是联邦政府颁发下来的，最基本的练气口诀，一切内功的基础。
是联邦无数高手和武学大师前赴后继，根据挖掘到的诸多超古代文明的练气口诀所开创出来的，这种《基础练气口诀》比较浅显，但是胜在平稳，不会出乱子。
也是整个联邦人类用来打基础的内功心法，但是一般来说，也就只有平民才会长期修炼《基础练气口诀》，那些天才，或者大家族，大门派的子弟，都是各自有各自的传承，都干脆不练这《基础练气口诀》。
原本楚云凡练的也是《基础练气口诀》，但是现在他的脑海之中有丹皇从小到大所有的记忆，丹皇的天赋在炼丹一道上，堪称是旷古烁今，前无古人后无来者，但是在武道修行上的天赋就很一般了，他到后来能够修炼到皇者的境界，很大程度上是因为他以无数的丹药硬生生堆上去的，平时还好，对上了同样的皇者，立刻就显出原形来了。
他甚至还能够清晰的记得丹皇临死前的想法。
枉我自诩天才，一生纵横风流，无人不让我三分，却原来都是假象，一切都是靠不住的，唯有自身的修行，才是横行天地的根本！
如果有来生，我一定要全力修行！
现在虽然是人人大修炼时代，否则要想修炼武学，除非有人肯教你，家学渊源，否则的话，就只能花钱购买武学，而这又是一大笔钱。
原本楚云凡还为这内功的事情而烦恼，现在就不必了，丹皇虽然本身修行武道的天赋一般，但是所会的神功绝学却真的是不少。
就算是其他的绝代皇者，都有求到他头上的时候，陆陆续续的他手中所掌握的诸多绝代皇者的神功绝学就很多了。
而且他已经选定了目标了，就是那个在他记忆中，可以同时对抗上百皇者的，伟岸的犹如神魔一般的身影。
那是即便丹皇那个诸皇辈出的年代之中，也是堪称举世无敌，所有人公认的亘古第一皇者，皇绝世。
在丹皇的记忆之中，这是一个他从未见过的绝世天才，皇绝世三岁开始习武，什么武学都是拈手就来，举一反三，看一遍就能够记下，三五遍之后，就能够领悟，五岁的时候，就已经声名鹊起，十岁的时候族中年轻一辈已经没有敌手。

十五岁他已经败尽族中高手，感觉到在族中再也没有办法提升自己的时候，便提三尺青锋，出门游历。
至十八岁，他便已经在天下间闯下赫赫声名，期间拜过名师，也交过知己，败过强敌，也杀过仇寇。
三十岁时他便与当时天下第一高手，司空错大战与天山之巅，这是他人生中第一次惨败。
败于司空错之后，他并不气馁，就地闭关十年，终于大彻大悟，神功大成。
此时他听闻自己家族遭到当世大寇屠戮一空，他便单枪匹马将三千五百六十七个贼寇斩杀以祭族人。
随后再约司空错一战，并且败之，成为当世第一高手。
五十岁岁时他便开辟了皇极门，著《皇极战典》，以为镇门之宝。
如果说，丹皇是在丹道上的无上天才，那么这皇绝世，就是武道上的无上天才，即便是在诸多皇者之中，他都是威压当代，所向无敌。

content_en:
It is impossible to explain at all, but even with today's technology, there are still many unsolved mysteries about super-ancient civilizations.
However, he believed that it was definitely not a dream, but that for some unknown reason, he had inherited the memory of the Dan Emperor.
His body also changed after that dream.
But he thinks this change is good. Now he feels more refreshed than ever before. The colors when he sees the world are more vivid, and the sounds are clearer. His whole body feels like there is endless power, and there is a surge of power in it.
He didn't dare to tell anyone about this change. He instinctively felt that if he told it, there would be an uproar. It was the memory of an emperor, and he might even be caught doing mouse slice research!
He was just a little strange. He didn't know where the Alchemy Emperor's Mountains and Rivers Map had gone, and the godhead wrapped in the Mountains and Rivers Map also didn't know where he had gone.
After thinking for a while, he still couldn't figure it out, so Chu Yunfan had no choice but to give up. Soon he put his mind back and started practicing.
A formula emerged in his mind, which was the "Basic Qi Training Formula". This "Basic Qi Training Formula" was issued by the federal government. It is the most basic Qi training formula and the basis of all internal skills.
It was created by countless masters and martial arts masters in the Federation based on the qi training formulas of many super-ancient civilizations that were unearthed. This "Basic Qi Training Formula" is relatively simple, but it is more stable and will not cause trouble.
It is also the inner strength method used by the entire federation to lay the foundation for human beings. However, generally speaking, only civilians can practice the "Basic Qi Training Formula" for a long time. Those geniuses, or the children of big families or sects, all have their own inheritance, and simply do not practice this "Basic Qi Training Formula".
Originally, Chu Yunfan also practiced the "Basic Qi Training Formula", but now he has all the memories of Dan Huang from childhood to adulthood in his mind. Dan Huang's talent in alchemy is unprecedented and unprecedented, but in martial arts. His talent in Taoist cultivation is very average. He was able to cultivate to the realm of an emperor later on, largely because he piled it on with countless pills. Normally, he was fine, but when he faced the same emperor, he immediately showed his true form.
He could even clearly remember the Alchemy Emperor's thoughts before his death.
I claim to be a genius in vain. I have been involved in many affairs throughout my life, and no one has denied me. However, it turns out that it is all an illusion, and everything is unreliable. Only my own practice is the foundation for my success in the world!
If there is an afterlife, I will definitely practice with all my strength!
Although this is an era of great cultivation for everyone, if you want to practice martial arts, unless someone is willing to teach you and you have a good family background, otherwise, you can only spend money to buy martial arts, and this is a lot of money.
Originally, Chu Yunfan was worried about this internal skill matter, but now there is no need. Although Danhuang himself has average talent in practicing martial arts, he really knows a lot of magical skills.
Even other peerless emperors would ask for help from him, and he gradually mastered many magical skills of peerless emperors.
And he has already chosen a target, that majestic figure like a god and demon who can fight against hundreds of emperors at the same time in his memory.
At that time, even in the era when emperors emerged in large numbers, the Dan Emperor was unrivaled in the world and recognized by everyone as the number one emperor in history.
In Dan Huang's memory, this was a peerless genius that he had never seen before. Huang Jueshi started practicing martial arts at the age of three. He learned all the martial arts at his fingertips. He could draw inferences from one instance and write it down after reading it once. After three or five times, he could understand it. When he was five years old, he had already become famous. When he was ten years old, the younger generation in the clan had no rivals.
At the age of fifteen, he had defeated all the masters in the clan and felt that there was no way to improve in the clan.When he was alone, he would carry the three-foot green sword and go out for travel.
By the age of eighteen, he had already achieved great fame in the world. During this period, he had worshiped famous teachers, made close friends, defeated powerful enemies, and killed enemy bandits.
When he was thirty years old, he fought against the top master in the world, Sikong Cuo, at the top of the Tianshan Mountains. This was the first time in his life that he was defeated miserably.
After being defeated by Sikong Cuo, he was not discouraged and stayed in seclusion for ten years. Finally, he achieved great enlightenment and achieved great success.
At this time, he heard that his family had been massacred by the most powerful bandits of the time, so he single-handedly killed 3,567 thieves as a sacrifice to his clan members.
Then he asked Sikong Cuo to fight again, and was defeated, becoming the world's best master.
When he was fifty years old, he opened the Huangji Sect and wrote the "Huangji War Code", which he regarded as the treasure of the gate.
If the Emperor of Dan is the supreme genius in the way of alchemy, then this emperor is the supreme genius in the way of martial arts. Even among many emperors, he is the most powerful and invincible in the world.
